name: joyscroller-videojs
description: Builds the Video.js 10 elements the player uses into ../videojs.js. Run `just videojs`.

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --banner:js="// Video.js 10 (@videojs/html, Apache-2.0, see videojs/LICENSE), bundled from assets/videojs by just videojs. Don't edit." --outfile=../videojs.js
